description:
Functional spec/files: Adapter.connection_options, Storage.Split and ConnectionWorker/pairing handoff own storage construction/preparation and synchronous request invocation using trusted sink options. Replace document_mfa plumbing with compatibility adapter to new sink contract; retain standalone callback mode until hosts migrate. Keep volatile routing/Mnesia runtime and guarded failure behavior; publish provider infrastructure through existing package child-spec boundary while host injects require_ram_schema.
Tests before code: current storage/worker/pairing tests plus bootstrap request before listener start, no State dependence, read/write/list/delete/clear ack shapes, callback failure latching, generation invalidation during call, timeout then retry, duplicate put silence, profile stability, cross-profile isolation, unchanged encoded records. Property tests for binding/profile determinism and isolated namespaces. Test authentication confirmation uses same storage request path after durable save.
Action reuse: extend Split.binding_options/prepare/document_call and Adapter existing methods; reuse Mnesia, GuardedStorage and pairing lifecycle. No copied backend or new Action. Sink is runtime-supplied per connection; no globals, secrets in status, disk session fallback or host dependencies. Unknown binding/error fails closed.
Mocking: host storage boundary and external WhatsApp only. Docs: package adapter_contracts and callback docs. Default backwards compatibility; never dual-write.

comments.text: Implementation owner: ../jido_chat_whatsapp. Keep durable edits in this source checkout, not only deps. Read parent epic Agent execution handoff before starting. Preserve existing reaction-normalization work.

Package setup and pairing handoff now support sink requests with legacy document_mfa compatibility. Isolated private request tests pass including real seven-second timeout and sanitized callback failure. Broad ZAQ migrated storage/linked-device tests passed 72 tests and 3 properties. Investigating package full-suite timeout before final validation. Added Engine expected_provider fence because authentication sinks precede a connector-scoped runtime.

Full package validation passed: 169 tests + 7 properties, no failures (13 live excluded); mix quality exit 0 including Dialyzer and Doctor. A preceding full run timed out; traced rerun completed in 57.4s with per-test 30s bound. Legacy callbacks remain compatible and no shared core changes were needed.
